source: Fresh public institutional, brokerage and fund-research coverage
note: These are external published views and portfolio disclosures. Ratings, targets and portfolio actions belong to the cited institution/source and are not recommendations by Indian Stock Pro.

items.title: Morgan Stanley downgrades PFC and REC
items.description: Morgan Stanley cut both Power Finance Corporation and REC from Overweight to Equal-Weight. Reported target prices were reduced to ₹410 for PFC and ₹360 for REC amid the proposed PFC-REC merger context.

items.title: Jefferies initiates Bajaj Housing Finance at Hold
items.description: Jefferies initiated coverage on Bajaj Housing Finance with a Hold rating and a ₹92 target, citing limited upside after the stock's strong loan-book growth had been reflected in valuation.

items.title: Kotak August 2026 Top Monthly Picks
items.description: Kotak's August list includes Amber Enterprises (Buy, ₹8,710 target), HDFC AMC (Add, ₹3,000), Indus Towers (Buy, ₹480), L&T (Add, ₹4,250) and Ujjivan Small Finance Bank (Buy, ₹85). These are the institution's published monthly calls.

items.title: HDFC Mutual Fund increased exposure to BSE, Reliance and Paytm
items.description: July portfolio activity reported by Prime Database showed HDFC Mutual Fund increasing exposure in a large number of stocks, with BSE, Reliance Industries and Paytm among the highlighted changes.

items.title: HDFC Defence Fund adds Cochin Shipyard and INDO-MIM
items.description: The HDFC Defence Fund added Cochin Shipyard and INDO-MIM and increased holdings in Hindustan Aeronautics, Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders and other defence names in its July portfolio disclosure.

items.title: ICICI Bank becomes the top mutual-fund holding
items.description: July mutual-fund portfolio data showed ICICI Bank overtaking HDFC Bank as the largest stock holding across mutual-fund portfolios, highlighting a notable shift in fund positioning.

items.title: Motilal Oswal August stock ideas
items.source: Motilal Oswal Wealth Management Research Desk
items.description: Motilal Oswal Wealth Management published six August stock ideas across large-, mid- and small-cap segments, including Adani Ports, Radico Khaitan and KFin Technologies.

items.title: Axis Securities August large-cap picks
items.description: Axis Securities' August large-cap list includes ICICI Bank and Bajaj Finance among eight highlighted large-cap ideas; the cited report gives stock-specific targets and overweight views.

items.title: SEBI prepares trading reforms to attract foreign capital
items.description: SEBI is preparing market-structure reforms aimed at improving access and reversing foreign-investor outflows, including changes to collateral, stock lending, short selling and the closing auction mechanism.
